ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has several concentric circles, and there are multiple radius lines emitted from the same center, dividing the circumferential direction into equal sectors. The gray shaded part is located on the upper-right side, and is an annular sector region immediately outside the smallest circle; it is bounded by the smallest circle, the next concentric circle, and two adjacent radius lines. Reasoning: The radius of the smallest circle is 2 feet, and the radius of each subsequent circle increases by 2 feet, so the inner radius of the annulus where the shading is located is 2, and the outer radius is 4. All the radius lines form 12 congruent central angles, so each central angle is 360°/12 = 30°. The shaded area is the area of a 30° annular sector: (30/360)π(4^2 - 2^2) = (1/12)π(16 - 4) = (1/12)·12π = π.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the shaded gray tile is one annular sector immediately outside the smallest circle, bounded by the smallest circle, the next concentric circle, and two adjacent radial lines on the right side. From the text, the smallest radius is 2 ft and the next circle has radius 4 ft, and the 12 central angles are congruent, so the shaded angle is 360/12 = 30 degrees. Compute the shaded area directly as a 30-degree sector of an annulus: (30/360) * pi * (4^2 - 2^2) = (1/12) * pi * 12 = pi.

推理：最小圆半径为 2 英尺，每个后续圆半径增加 2 英尺，所以阴影所在环带的内半径为 2，外半径为 4。所有半径线形成 12 个全等中心角，因此每个中心角为 360°/12 = 30°。阴影面积是一个 30° 的环形扇形面积：
(30/360)π(4^2 - 2^2) = (1/12)π(16 - 4) = (1/12)·12π = π。
